svg.title: One edit: how many chunks change?
svg.text: One edit: how many chunks change?
Add 7 words to the top of travel-policy, then re-chunk.
the 7 new words push every boundary along
Re-embed all six. [travel-policy#w080] now cites different text.
Only the edited section needs re-embedding.
Section IDs such as travel-policy#daily-limits-by-city keep their meaning.
EVERY CHUNK CARRIES ITS DOCUMENT'S METADATA
Recording permissions is not enforcing them: that is Day 14.
